title: Dust & Redemption — Original frontier sound project
author: stteak / Codex procedural asset production

effects.design: Broad low powder report, bright cylinder transient, short dry decay.
Sharper crack than revolver, narrow metallic bolt snap and lower dust tail.
Softened distant firearm report, reduced high-frequency attack and body.
Short sandstone impact with three quiet gravel fragments.
Damped cloth/body impact, deliberately restrained and non-graphic.
Low breath-like noise and falling tone that remains distinct from gunfire.
Three timed steel clicks and a restrained spring rattle.
Dry earth crunch with a low boot thump and no pitched note.
Two rising sine pulses; no resemblance to real emergency-service sirens.
Original sparse A3–E4–B4 voiced pluck, staggered 80 ms apart.
Quiet wood-and-string selection tick with quick release.

music.title: Dustfall: open-road ostinato
music.origin: Newly authored numerical note sequence for this game; no recording, sample library or reference melody.
music.voice: One decaying triangle pluck; 1 second duration and low amplitude.
music.percussion: 47 Hz decaying sine on alternating beats, 0.1 seconds, falling to 70% pitch.
music.arrangement: Sparse eight-beat loop with three rests. No vocals or sampled instruments. Playback suspended with the game.
